company_info.company_description: "Sunrise believes in the positive energy of sunshine, and the power of the sun to uniquely power our world. Whether you want more control over your electricity costs or an easy way to join the growing movement to power the world with clean, abundant sunshine, we make going solar a positive experience.Our customers are the centre of our energy systems. Everything we do revolves around ensuring you get the Solar Spectrum Energy System that is right for you – both today and tomorrow. Plus, sunshine improves the environment by tons – literally. So together, we can make a huge difference.Please come and visit our store located across the street from the post office in Wodonga."

reviews.review_description: Sunrise Rise solar, sales good and the quote was good, without alterations. Installation was handled by subcontractors, Install began on a Monday, the panels did not arrive. After a week they arrived and the install was completed. Polite ok, punctual ok, but we did ring to find out what happened to our panels, an email from sunrise the day before the panel install to organise times and an apology  for the delay.    Grid connection has been organised to be completed on the 21st June.
Installed with LG Chem RESU10H_R 10kWh Battery  (not subject to recall)

Excellent experience. Staff on time, easy to converse with, very professional. Apart from the Solar unit and the panels you wouldn’t know that been - place left tidy and no rubbish left. Helpful with effort to set my mobile in action - has been in touch since.
No customer service dented all the roof not prepared to Recife it so I’m out of dollars to repair roof

In total I received about 15 quotes from 10 installers both local and Sydney based and in the end I went with a quote from Sunrise Power Solutions.David at Sunrise was very patient with me while I tried to make my mind up on what solar set up was right for me, he didn't have the "Snake oil saleman" vibe that others companies I spoke with had and was willing to match products and prices, he replied to my many emails and answered my calls in a timely manner and it was his customer service in the end that won my business.Installation had a tiny hiccup but once brought to the attention of David it was sorted out very quickly and overall very happy with. It was completed within a day and they removed my old solar set up and took it away for me which was included in the price so that was one less thing to worry about.

Sunrise Power Solutions knew that we had a busted Hot Water system. I told them what I wanted. They provided a quote we got approval and then we waited and waited, was told that he could not get one until June. I got on the phone and got him one in a matter of an hour and they assured us that they could ship and we'd have it the next day the next day, nothing. They claimed they were sorting out shipping, then he came back with another unit we could get, I did not want that brand, and then another brand, the same that made the system that was defective and no way was I going to go with them, so a week later he offered to refund us and the only good thing he can state is that he refunded me within minutes...  I got a new installer with the help of the supplier of the system that we wanted, and with in 2 hours, the installer was here at the house, we got a quote for the same system but $700 cheaper and guess what will be here tomorrow and will be installed tomorrow, and to think I wasted a week trying to get Sunrise Solar to help me and do the right thing too...I will never use them or never recommend them to anyone.
Particullary pleasant and helpfull. Nice to have face to face contact. First class in every stage of the technical aquisition.
Very helpful and explained everything clear to me.Really enjoyed the process from start to finish.

Our installer was hit badly by COVID absences, and didn't call us for over a week after Solar Quotes send out our details.It was worth the wait. Andrew had done his homework and came with prepared quotes for 3 different options including one with a battery, which i had asked for. Whilst his quote was a little higher, his warranty was also higher, with premium panels and an option to expand once i have finished my house extensions. I am currently waiting for my very busy painter to complete painting the roof and the installation will commence. I will send an update after the install is completed.
Very friendly and helpful, followed up after installationTied up afterOrganised grid connection
Highly professional, thorough and diligent. Exceptionally good support and communication throughout the process. Whole team were outstanding.

The whole process through the 1st time we stepped through the door to the complete installation was very efficient, keeping us informed of what was happening at every step of the way. Andrew was extremely knowledgeable and helpful steering us towards a system to suit our requirements. The installation team were polite, very efficient and worked extremely well together.When it came to organising our connection to the grid, our Project Manager Ryan constantly chased the power provider on our behalf, so we didn't have to worry about it, making the whole process stress free, and for this reason we would highly recommend Sunrise Power Solutions to be your Solar Installer.

We are so glad we chose to go through Sunrise Power Solutions, we had competitor quotes, and although Sunrise wasn't the cheapest option, it really does matter to pay that little bit extra, for the service, the quality and the amazing team that work at Sunrise. From starting at the quote right, through to install and the after sales process was nothing short of amazing. all the team members really took the time to get to know my needs and wants and nothing at all was too much trouble. I HIGHLY recommend Sunrise power solutions and will to everyone i know thinking or wanting solar.
Professional and friendly staff that help guide you through the process
We were very happy with the whole process, from getting the quote to installation. Each step was clearly explained, all staff members were polite, professional and friendly at all times.

Another installer let us down by not being slow and bureaucratic and not being sufficiently pro active and agile to make sure that our second battery to expand our storage was ordered in time while supplies were limited during a model phase out. David from Sunrise gave us a very reasonable quote to take over the job and supply and install the battery compatible with our existing one. However despite Sunrise best efforts to make sure we got the correct battery while stock was still available on installation day the wholesale supplier delivered the wrong battery model which was incompatible with our existing battery. Although these were stocks of the correct battery still available when Sunrise first quoted. By now the battery we needed was superseded and no stock was available. Sunrise worked tirelessly for weeks to find a solution including searching high and low for any remaining stock of the compatible model and a technical solution to allow the two different models to be combined. In the end Sunrise traded-in our existing one year old battery for two new batteries at a modest increase in cost compared to one new battery. None of this problem was caused by Sunrise, they were not the ones initially tardy, on the contrary they were always very prompt. It was not them who delivered the wrong battery. However they took our problem on as their problem and delivered a working solution for us a a attractive cost. These are the guys to have on your side when things go wrong.
Sales quoting was very helpful and informative and the installation above expectationStill waiting for grid connection

I was looking for a honest and straight to the point advice. On top of that I got a selection of products to choose from and to meet any budget.Reliable and compitant installation. The best before and after service. The whole team and installers went above and beyond. I really liked Bree my sales consultant.My next mission is to look at getting a Tesla Battery.

The sales process was excellent. Everything was made clear from the start.Installation was earlier than expected and well done.Customer service was great. Grid connection was established and it worked very well.
Fast and responsive customer service. Organised a range of quotes.From quote to installation was very quick.Follow up emails and organise connection after installation.

They are the only company that listened to what I wanted. I had lived off grid for over 30yrs and wanted to have the same but on grid. David and his team took the time and helped me with solar, Batteries and new heat pump hot water system. I highly recommend them to all my friends.
Sunrise were very professional and helpful. Responsive to change of spec with quick turnaround and ongoing support. Great value. Thanks to David, Andrew and the team.
Very clear information provided that assisted n making decision to go ahead and configuration of system. Installation went smoothly despite difficulties with roof.

From the initial quote to the final install Sunrise made the process easy and painless. Provided us with all the options and were happy to discuss our needs in depth. Kept us informed throughout on where things were and and delivered on everything they promised.Sunrise went out of their way to help us out.Everything was done neatly and professionally. All the trades people were polite, knew what they were doing and were happy to explain everything in detail. Sunrise followed up to make sure we were satisfied and were happy to answer any questions we had. They even came out post installation to give us a detailed walk through of the monitoring app for the system and tips on getting the most out of it.Could not be happier.
Sales / quote very well explainedGood profesional install team, Tidy install.Still in the process of grid connection. organised by installer
Clear and precise quoteInstallation was punctual and the guy’s were very professionalGreat customer service. Kept in contact during and after installation.

The sales and quoting process was excellent. I looked at other installers and sunrise was the only one to take the time and come to my premises to inspect the location of the installation , prior to giving a written quote.The installers were very polite and arrived on the day that they said they would. There was no rubbish left from the installation after they were completed.Sunrise organized the installation,electrical safety compliance and finally the grid connection with my preferred electrical supplier.
The whole experience was extremely professional.Charmaine was very helpful from start to finish making the experience very stress free.

The whole experience of having the solar organised and installed, has been very professional and of a high standard. From the sales team to the installers, it was great customer service. I have been very happy and would highly recommend them to anyone considering solar.

The team at Sunrise Power Solutions were very helpful and professional.  David answered all my questions, without being pushy in any way.  The installation went smoothly.  I like the fact that they are a local company, and are keen to have an ongoing relationships with us, giving us advice as we need it, on appliances, batteries and making the most of our solar power.  I know that if anything eventually breaks down, they will still be here to fix it, unlike some companies.  I highly recommend Sunrise Power Solutions.
We could not find fault with this company,from start to finish.

The sales process was terrific, good knowledge of products they have to offer.Quote was clear and easy to understand and in the installation went very well with great placement of the inverter and panels.Great support setting up the app to monitor the system.
Very pleased with the quoting and sales process. Quality Solar Edge system performing very well in all seasons. A 6.6kW array spread across three aspects of roof: West, North and East.
A no fuss approach with quality and seamless install.t communication and professional trade install

the quotation process was clear and fully explained through outthe installers were polite, knowledgeable and again explained the system once installedSunrise Power Solutions are still in touch and will review my power bills once we have had a full billing period on solar.Very happy i went with this company

This instillation was an extension to an existing system and the sales person was able to find a way to add on to the system with only minor changes to the existing system. The new design was quoted and displayed with a brief visit from one of the sales team, the simplicity of the new design gave Sunrise the successful quote.The instillation was extremely well organised, and all tradesmen came on time, and left as planned, with the system up and running with very little interuption to our daily routine.Sunrise staff contacted us soon after the instillation to check that the system was operating satisfactorily, because this was an extension to an existing system there was no need to organise a grid connection.
Careful assessment of teh most suitable system for my needs.Professional and courteous installation process.Good follow up to ensure WiFi connection
Excellent job & well done to Sunrise Power Solutions for everything.

The quoting process was disappointing as only one company visited and quoted. Two others promised but did not arrive One Melbourne based company quoted without visiting. I don't know how they got our details.The salesperson was prompt, pleasant and informative.The installation was disappointing as the 6.6 kw system requested was not installed. The installers claimed the top level of the A Frame building was not suitable for panels something the salesman did not comment on or that I could dispute at the time.We now have a 3.5 system instead.Apart from that issue everything went smoothly.

From the first phone call after we contacted Sunrise, we knew that we had made a great choice. Quoting process was very smooth with all our questions answered clearly. When we came down to two quotes, we asked both companies to compare and tell us why we should go with them. Again, Sunrise were clear in their response and explained what we needed to know to make a decision. Even though Sunrise was slightly more expensive, we went with them and we are very glad that we did. Removal of the old system and installation of the new all went very smoothly and well within the acceptable timeframes.The installers were magnificent, polite, and accepting of our wishes. They went beyond their remit to explain a few technical matters and we were left assured. They were some of the tidiest tradespeople we have had around for a good while. It is early days yet but the system seems to be working very well, reaching its peak output on sunny days as might be expected, but also working quite well on overcast days. Customer service throughout has been excellent. Sunrise Power Solutions is highly recommended.
I am now paying my whole gas bill with my solar credits. It has been excellent service all the way through.

We needed to update quotes and sunrise power solutions were more than helpful even telling us there was a better system available for less, which actually allowed us to go up in size for even more power.The installation was well done and the trades people used polite, informative and top quality.Customer service was exceptional with calls returned quickly if not answered directly, updates on installation and arrival times made for a seamless installation.We highly recommend Sunrise Power Solutions to anyone looking to install solar, we will be dealing with them again with future projects at the Branch.

The sales/quoting process was relaxed and truthful and very informative especially about the differences between the string effects of the panels and having individual inverters on each panel plus they asked what I wanted rather than tell me what they will give me. The installation crew were great,friendly,punctual and tidy,got it all installed on 21st of January 2020 and good follow up by all involved and had me connected in a coupla days (already had smartbox installed from previous small system) so updating system worked out well.Thanx very much for your suggestions.

A few years ago, Sunrise set me up with a 6.6kW solar system, which has alway done exactly what it was supposed to do, with no problems. So, when I wanted to extend with another 4kW of solar and a Powerwall 2, I went straight back to them and again, it went in with no problems and does exactly what it's supposed to do.

Jodi and I have been thinking about Solar Power for 12 months or so.  We spoke to several companies and obtained quotes.  A friend, who had a system installed by Sunrise Power Solutions, recommended them to us.  We spoke to them over the phone and were given several options.  We then attended their office in Wodonga and were given further information about the options available along with literature which was relevant to what were looking at.Several months after obtaining the quote we again attended the office of Sunrise Power Solutions and further discussed what we wanted and again obtained another quote.  Several days after obtaining this new quote we purchased a solar system from Sunrise Power Solutions.About two weeks after paying the deposit the system was installed.  The installers attended a day earlier as it was forecast to rain on the date instillation was to take place.  Installation was completed in a day.  The installers were very efficient, polite and talked us through how the system worked.We could not be happier with Sunrise Power Solutions.  They completed all the work and lodged paperwork to the energy company to have them attend and connect our solar system to the grid. We have nothing negative to say about Sunrise Power Solutions.  The things that impressed us most about them are :  There was no pressure on us to purchase by the salesperson.  They listened and advised us of the best system for us and explained the reasoning for this.  Installation was completed in a timely manner and very professional manner.  Follow up from them after the system has been installed.
Simple & easy to understand & Coffee Mug was excellent.Polite & very tidy & punctual.(Installer)Customer Service was excellent with all the Staff.
The process from start to finish was flawless and very professional.

Chris was very professional and definitely knew the products. He didn't try and sell a system we didn't need, instead he tailored and made the solar package to our exact requirements. Thank you very much.
Everything was easy and smooth.  Quote was easy to understand. Installation was quick and easy.  Grid connection went really well.  Not one complaint.

Everything about this purchase was positive.  The sales/quote process was simple, informative, responsive to questions, clearly passionate about their product but without being pushy or forceful.  Installation was prompt, professional, non-disruptive, going above and beyond.  Quality products installed and great ongoing communication and support.
I couldnt be happier with Sunrise. Brianna was so responsive at all times and provided really good information about the products and the process. Thank you.

The team at Sunrise Power Solutions have been attentive to all my inquiries throughout the installation of our new Tesla Powerwall 2. David receives a special mention here for keeping me in the loop every step of the way and made the entire process hassle free for us.I had been considering a Tesla Powerwall battery for a few years prior and had a poor experience dealing with metro-based suppliers prior who gave false promises on delivery times / installation dates etc .. the moment I saw that Sunrise Power Solutions had become a certified installer I got in touch right away and the entire process was less than 3 weeks from order placement to install and activation.It goes to show what supporting local businesses can do especially in these challenging times where customer service has gradually been replaced with cut-throat pricing / pressure sale tactics when in our case dealing with Sunrise Power Solutions proved that old fashioned customer service should never go unnoticed hence why I felt compelled to write this review to inspire those in the market for anything solar to make them your first stop for the best service in town.

Sunrise Power Solutions P/L Wodonga 3690 ,  was so great to deal with they came around looked at our requirements worked out the best package for our needs they was helpful with filling out paperwork , and the installation went so smooth and the tradesmen was so helpful and they cleaned up on completions of the job and then they took us though the operation of the Inverter they was so polite to deal with,  as was the Office staff , we have been puling of as we did notwant the hassles but now we are so happy as it was so smooth from start to finish .

I rang on Monday and the initial consultation was the next day. I was very impressed by everything done.Installation was professional, polite and they phoned to advance to change my installation day which was great. Punctual, neat and tidy workers who worked as a excellent team.Customer service was good, though I had a problem to connect with the grid ( I’m not very computer savvy) So once I explained my problem it was quickly sorted out.These people are local which is very good.
Fantastic company to deal with. Explained everything and the after same service has also been great!

From the time I contacted Sunrise and for weeks post installation, no question or follow up was too hard. I can't speak highly enough of the customer service representatives especially Brianna who exceeded expectations and was only too happy to help through every step of the process. She ensured I was fully understanding of the product they were able to offer me and I trusted her thorough knowledge of the product. Would highly recommend!
Easy and understandable quote, installation was a dream and the guys were extremely polite and tidy.Every question I've had has been answered in a timely fashion and very helpful in general.

All went really well from the initial quote until final inspection and approval. A good local company doing good things, another reason to support local businesses rather than those that have no interest in our region.

We had a 6.65kw system put in, every contact we had during the process was professional, friendly, informative and willing.The assistance during quoting was terrific, the guys that did the instal were brilliant, punctual, clean and tidy, friendly and professional.We had a follow up with Andrew as we didn’t have wifi when it the system was installed (new build) who came out and set it all up.Brilliant service and highly recommended

Quoting was provided a day after discussion on what I enquired about. Adjusted positioning of panels on speaking with Simon the installer on the team arrival. The guys were polite, worked very efficiently and finished the job by 5.30pm after beginning at 7.30am. The customer service at the office was great with enquiries dealt with in a prompt fashion by front of office staff and Andrew
Helpful installer that changed the placement of the panels to increase the power output

Quote was simple, I know the solar market  and this company was offering great products with fair pricing. Trades people installed the system without a fuss the only electricians I know to clean up there mess. Would recommend.

It has been a painless and flawless transition. From help with providing finance support to constant contact re progress of quote to installation, to dealing with one's power provider to after instillation support. Typically responds to emails within 1 hour and always returns phone calls if you leave a message and can't get onto them straight away.The installers lacked a bit of common courtesy, smoking inside our yard with nil regard to owners preference and not cleaning up after themselves. (Still finding bits of wire off cuts in lawn and gutter). They were however, quick and efficient in their instillation and it looks like they did a good quality job.

The Sunrise Power Solutions team arrived on time and wasted no time in making a start. 4 qualified electricians got to work and literally wasted no time in completing the job. By 4.00 pm, they had installed a 10 kwh micro inverter system on the roof of my house and I was already saving $$$’s off my power bill.  And despite the system coming with a high level of packaging, the boys left the place as clean as when they arrived, all waste going back in the truck. The install is perfect, tidy, looks good,  and with the provided app I can see exactly what the system is doing at any time of day.  The only issue was with the control panel being located a distance away from the router which meant the required wifi connection to access the app was not possible. No problem, Andrew, the owner of SPS was over a couple of days later to install a wifi extender. Plugged it in and we’re all good.Highly recommended.
I felt really comfortable during the whole process. It feel like the team actually care about their customers and getting what is right for you.

The whole process was fantastic. From the initial site visit, planning meeting, installation and review, Andrew and his team were top professionals. Andrew was great at developing a plan that accommodated the orientation and logistical problem of our two storey house. He was very clear and honest about the projected performance of each panel system and what would best suit a variety of lifestyle situations.The installation team were great on the day. Arrived on time, didn't leave a mess and stayed back to discuss the install with me. I received a phone call not long after to check on how the installation went and to coach me through the next steps.Very happy with the whole process and the amazing professionalism of the Sunrise Power team.

We have a rather complicated situation involving the removal of our current solar systems and consolidating into one system with a battery. Installation yet to happen but Sunrise Power Solutions conducted a thorough review of our usage and future needs before providing us with a solution. Their cost was similar to others we received  but they are local and their customer service was excellent.

From the first meeting with Andrew, through to the quotation negotiation, through to the installation and finally the post installation connection & app set up - it has been seamless. I would recommend anyone interested in exploring Solar to seriously consider Sunrise Power and certainly have them on your shortlist of suppliers.

Sunrise are great people to work with.Quotation process was easy and they were helpful and well informed.Installation was on a date that suited us.Installers were punctual and polite and did a great job.Grid connection was also quick and Sunrise provided the required guidance and forms very promptly.

Easy to understand quoting. Very friendly and helpful service.  Very quick turnaround, installed within a few days.  Polite and tidy installation.  Everything organised for me, didn't need to do anything to get connected.  Would highly recommend.
Was very happy with service and productInstaller was very polite tidy and punctual

Jacob & the two boys who installed the solar were excellent, were professional & tidy. Job Well done!All the team at Sunrise were very helpful with everything along the way as to setting my system & I would highly recommend them to anyone else.

From the time that we arranged for a quote fro David to the after sales phone call post installation we couln't have asked for more. The quote was done professionally and all of the concerns we had were addressed. The system they quoted on gave us the benefit of good quality panels and inverter as well as power optimisers on each panel to alleviate our concerns with the possibility of damaged panels (from stray golf balls). The price was in the ball park of the range of quotes we received and was acceptable for our budget. Everything in the pack provided, helped us to make our decision to accept the quote. Specs on each of the alternatives provided all the technical information we needed. The quote was straightforward and easy to understand, giving us projections of what we could expect from the installation.The installation was event free. When Jessie, Henry and the boys turned up at the agreed time they took us through the process and then suggested some minor changes to the installation (including removing the Foxtel dish that would have shadowed one of the panels). Everything they did was done without any hassle and they cleaned up afterwards. The system was up and running in no time. Some minor problems getting the Solar Edge app installed were sorted out and everything is now working fine.From the information being relayed from the app our system is working fine and we're getting the type of solar production we were expecting. its great looking at the amount of self consumption and knowing that we're well on the way to saving some considerable dollars from this installation.A big thank you to Sunrise Power Solutions, you've done a great job.
I have enjoyed the service received at Sunrise that I have referred 5 of my closest friends.

David from Sunrise provided us with a completed quote via email prior to coming out to see us.  This gave us the opportunity to digest his suggestions, check up on the products he was recommending etc.  Once he came to our home, he was very friendly, courteous and enthusiastic about both the product and the benefits we would get from it.  The installation was quicker than we anticipated ... all the guys were very nice to deal with and tidied up after themselves.  The customer service was absolutely fantastic ... everything was done for us ... we didn't have to chase anyone or anything up ... it was completely hassle free.  Running our own business where we always aim to give great customer service - it was so very nice to receive some back.  Graeme and Jenny

From the moment we walked into the office we were treated to great service. The quotes were completed and explained to us as they were generated. An on-site inspection was conducted and required roof repairs addressed. Communication was consistent and regular. The installers arrived on time, courteous, worked quietly for the first hour before putting on music and using power tools. Cleaned up and took everything off-site. Follow up and their role in connection to the grid has been timely. Thank you to all the team.

Right from when we first contacted Sunrise Solar - everything was very easy, friendly and helpful. The first thing that occurred was that we were sent a detailed quote that we had plenty of time to study before meeting with David.  That meant that we could be prepared for the meeting and not overwhelmed with information - it was more of an opportunity for us to ask specific questions.  David was so helpful and friendly that we made our decision almost immediately to us Sunrise Solar!  From then on it was quick and simple ... from the paperwork thru til the end of the installation, everything ran smoothly and even ahead of time.  Great job everyone ... many thanks ... Jenny & Graeme

Having been messed about with another company for nearly a year I finally gave up on them and went with Sunrise Solutionts. I should have done this months ago. Though we live in Khancoban, some distance away and expect delays they were quick and efficient. Within 3 weeks of my original phone call the solar was up and finished. A great company to deal with, very helpful staff and workmen. They actually hooked me up on the day it was done and showed me how it all worked. All I need now is the power supplier to install a new meter which Solar have arranged with them. Thank you everybody for a job well done.
Easy to deal with, fairly priced, installed quickly and neatly on the day organized without any issues.

Since building new home I haven't been impressed with the quality of work from contractors so far, there are many reasons I have this opinion & not because I'm hard to please but because I'm a tradesman myself so have insight into what one should expect. Sunrise Power Solutions installed my solar system & finally a company with tradesman who are pleasant, on time, do quality work, clean up after themselves & office staff that actually return calls/emails. Overall a pleasant experience & would recommend them without hesitation.

The quotation process was factual, accurate and offered options. The installation was professionally done in a timely manner. The workmen on site were polite, helpful and ensured their safety on site. All waste was cleaned up and the garden left clean and tidy.
Happy to recommend, very professional, friendly and helpful. David and the staff were great to deal with. Installers were great and cleaned up when finshed. Their products are high quality.

Great experience all round!From initial contact and quote to installation & final payment the process was seamless.The boys who installed the system were lovely & looked for the best installation configuration to suit my roofline.I’m very happy with my decision to go with Sunrise Power Solutions. Both Simon & Kisha were helpful & great to deal with. I’ve already recommended them to a few of my friends!

This was my second system purchase from Sunrise, I was so impressed the first time with their customer service and professional installation that I had no hesitation in engaging with them again. The installation team were punctual, friendly and efficient and cleaned up after themselves. Should I decide to build again, I will not hesitate to contact Sunrise.
Sales person very professional, pleasant.Trades personal were punctual, polite, professional.Customer service could not be faulted.
Professional service from start to finish. Quality product an fantastic install.I highly recommend Sunrise power solutions.
Simple quote process.Installation was quick and they even cleaned up.Organised grid connection  and app setup, all very easy and staff were great.

From quote to installation it was a seamless experience. Quote was very informative. Finance was easy to organise. Installation was completed in a timely fashion at a time that was convenient to me. I didn't have to chase up the elec company they contacted me. Very easy process

The sales person Bri, was polite efficient and knowledgeable. We correctly chose a system to handle shade conditions.The installation guys were great, did a good job and yes, tidy and polite. Fitted into a tight schedule at the end of the year.Customer service has been spot on. There was an issue in the installation that was quickly resolved and problem sorted.They organised the grid connection and the lovely Bri. continually followed up.In a busy time this was a job well done.
Two installers came in the morning and they finished about 2pm. Friendly people.
Install went well. Assisted with tjegrid conection.A job well done.

Punctual, well prepared. I was given a presentation folder with  information about the  company, Solar products and options. Very knowledgeable,friendly answered my questions or contacted someone who could. Showed me on her laptop my roof and options for panels layout for optimal solar. Went through all Government rebates, and no interest loan,my final payment. Prepared the quote in front of me and emailed it to me. The steps to Solar in the State of Victoria in my presentation  folder  has been very useful. The Grid connection was delayed because of Covid and Christmas ,however an inspector approved the system last week and my electricity provider has been informed. I am now waiting on Ausnet to reconfigure my metre.I have recommended Sunrise Power Solutions to my friends and family.

The team at Sunrise Power Solutions have supported us consistently from the first initial inquiry, throughout the sales and quoting process, applications for the government grants,installation and ongoing after sales customer service.Briana, Charmaine and Kishna are to be  commended for their professionalism and amazing customer service and sense of humour. There was never a question that was left unanswered and we felt valued as a customer.The installer Zac and his "accomplice" Jacob, were, professional prompt,polite, consultative, informative and friendly.They ensured that the solar unit was connected to the grid and operational, they also installed the Fusion App to my phone!What we envisaged may be a stressful purchase and installation was actually completed without stress and with consummate professionalism.

Initial consultation with Andrew Purves was professional with prompt actioning to my request. On installation day "solar battery" with compatible inverter, the tradesman lead by Simon were professional with the installation. A good investment over all, power bill......what power bill.Thankyou TEAM, overall a very satisfied customer, Sunrise Power Solutions - "Second to None"

Great experience doing business with Sunrise.  They were thorough in establishing what we wanted and designed a system to do just that.  The installation is of the highest quality.  The installation team turned up when they said they would and did a fantastic job fitting the system on one of the hottest days of the summer so far.  It must have been like an oven up there on our tin roof but they went up and got on with it, without complaint.Sunrise organised our grid connection but Origin let the side down a bit.  It will be almost a month since the install before we get a new meter fitted and can go live.  No hassles, just the Christmas holidays have slowed everything down.Price wise, Sunrise were not the cheapest but price wasn't the primary concern here, quality was.  And we certainly got that.Would I recommend this company?  Yes.Would I do business with them again?  Yes.
No matter how many times i rang and how many questions a had. The were always friend and prepared to explain and answer any questions. installation day as promised-big plus.
